title: 179. Asteroid Collision

examples.explanation: The 10 and -5 collide resulting in 10. The 5 and 10 never collide.
The 8 and -8 collide exploding each other.
The 2 and -5 collide resulting in -5. The 10 and -5 collide resulting in 10.

hints: Keep survivors in a stack; only a right-moving top and a left-moving incoming asteroid can collide.
While the incoming left-moving asteroid destroys smaller right-moving tops, pop them; if sizes are equal, pop the top and discard the incoming one.
